_comment: Tier-2 for skfem wave#1, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: skfem >= 12 needs MeshQuad.init_tensor because the older MeshQuad((nx,ny)) constructor was removed, signalled by TypeError 'MeshQuad() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given' or AttributeError 'type object MeshQuad has no attribute __init__'. Ran: MeshQuad((10,10)), MeshQuad(10,10), a Basis on the resulting object, and MeshQuad.init_tensor on an 11x11 grid. Printed: BOTH QUOTED MESSAGES ARE ABSENT and MeshQuad((10,10)) RAISES NOTHING -- skfem 12's Mesh is a dataclass whose first field is doflocs, so the tuple becomes coordinates and the call returns a MeshQuad1 with a 1-D point array [10.0, 10.0] and a single bogus element. The only thing emitted at construction is a bare stdout line 'Unable to calculate global DOF locations.', not a warning and not an exception. The failure surfaces later at Basis(...) as IndexError 'too many indices for array: array is 1-dimensional, but 2 were indexed', a message that never mentions MeshQuad. MeshQuad(10,10) raises IndexError 'tuple index out of range', also not the quoted TypeError. init_tensor gives the expected 100 elements / 121 vertices.
expect_in_output: Unable to calculate global DOF locations.
